column2: The mere sight of [From.GetTitledFirstName] fills you with contempt. By the old law of the north a grudge between free warriors may be carried to the holm, a bare skerry in the cold sea, and fought out there with shield and axe before witnesses. Whoever walks off the holm has the right of it, and the gods will have seen it. Call the cur to holmgang and settle this once and for all?
Send word. I call [From.GetHerHim] to the holm!
No. I might actually lose...
Challenged to holmgang!

That mad dog [From.GetTitledFirstName] has found the nerve to challenge you to holmgang! If you accept, the two of you will row out to a bare skerry and fight with shield and axe until one yields, flees or dies, and the loser pays the winner by holm law. If you refuse, the skalds will sing of your shame in every longhouse from the Sea of Claws to the Chaos Wastes.
By [This.Religion.GetRandomGodName], I accept!
I... I need not prove myself against that fool.
You accept the challenge.
You refuse the challenge.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] sends word that [From.GetSheHe] accepts your challenge! One week from now the two of you will meet on the holm. There is no turning back now.
I shall count the days.
The coward [From.GetTitledFirstName] will not face you on the holm! Now the whole north knows what [From.GetSheHe] is worth, and the skalds already have the first verse.
I am not surprised.

It is still dawn when you wade ashore on the holm and find [holmgang_defender.GetTitledFirstName] waiting. Ravens wheel over the skerry and the witnesses watch from their boats. An ox-hide is pegged to the rock, and whoever is driven off it three times has lost. You heft shield and axe while your foe does the same. The insults fly for a while, and then the battle is joined!

It is still dawn when you wade ashore on the holm and find [holmgang_challenger.GetTitledFirstName] waiting. Ravens wheel over the skerry and the witnesses watch from their boats. An ox-hide is pegged to the rock, and whoever is driven off it three times has lost. You heft shield and axe while your foe does the same. The insults fly for a while, and then the battle is joined!
My axe will carve you a new smile!

With a mighty blow you split [holmgang_loser.GetFirstName]'s shield in half. Without a shield to hide behind, [holmgang_loser.GetSheHe] swings wildly at your face, and though you pull away you feel blood running down your cheek from a deep gash. Annoyed, you land one last blow and cleave [holmgang_loser.GetHerHis] skull. By holm law, a share of the dead's goods is yours.

[holmgang_loser.GetFirstName] hurls [holmgang_loser.GetHerselfHimself] at you, but you take the flurry of blows on your shield. You heave your foe over your shoulder, and as [holmgang_loser.GetSheHe] falls you turn and open [holmgang_loser.GetHerHis] throat with your axe. [holmgang_loser.GetFirstName] is dead before [holmgang_loser.GetSheHe] hits the rock - a clean kill. By holm law, a share of the dead's goods is yours.

With a mighty blow you split [holmgang_loser.GetFirstName]'s shield in half. Without a shield to hide behind, [holmgang_loser.GetSheHe] swings wildly at your face, and though you pull away you feel blood running down your cheek. Annoyed, you drive your foe across the hide and off it three times, bleeding from several wounds, until [holmgang_loser.GetSheHe] yields and pays the weregild.

[holmgang_loser.GetFirstName] charges at you with [holmgang_loser.GetHerHis] axe, but you turn the blows aside with your shield and smash its rim into [holmgang_loser.GetHerHis] face. Before your foe can recover you have driven [holmgang_loser.GetHerHim] off the hide three times, and [holmgang_loser.GetSheHe] yields and pays the weregild. Victory is yours!

You bang your axe against your shield and advance on [holmgang_loser.GetFirstName] with a great battle cry. The color drains from your foe's face. [holmgang_loser.GetSheHeCap] drops shield and axe with a shriek, leaps into the sea and swims away from the holm, nerve broken. The witnesses in the boats laugh until they weep.
Victory is mine.

You swing at [holmgang_winner.GetFirstName], but [holmgang_winner.GetSheHe] takes the blow on [holmgang_winner.GetHerHis] shield, and your axe sticks fast in the wood. As you struggle to pull it free, your foe lands a heavy blow in your flank. Wounded, you fall to the rock with no choice but to yield, and by holm law you must pay the weregild.

You swing at [holmgang_winner.GetFirstName], but [holmgang_winner.GetSheHe] takes the blow on [holmgang_winner.GetHerHis] shield, and your axe sticks fast in the wood. As you struggle to pull it free, your foe's axe comes down on you again and again. Badly maimed, you fall to the rock with no choice but to yield, and by holm law you must pay the weregild.

You swing at [holmgang_winner.GetFirstName], but [holmgang_winner.GetSheHe] takes the blow on [holmgang_winner.GetHerHis] shield, and your axe sticks fast in the wood. As you struggle to pull it free there is a sharp pain, and you look down to find your foe's axe buried deep in your gut. You sink to your knees on the cold rock as the ravens come down and the darkness takes you...

As [holmgang_winner.GetFirstName] advances on you with shield and axe held ready, a terror like nothing you have ever known takes hold of you. You throw your weapons aside, run blindly for the water and leap in with only one thought: to get off the holm alive. The laughter from the boats follows you all the way to the shore.
I... yield.
The gods are watching...
Blood for the Blood God... even mine.
The better part of valor! The better part of valor!

You and [holmgang_defender.GetFirstName] fall upon one another, and splinters fly as axe meets shield. You are evenly matched, and the fight drags on through the day. When the sun sinks into the sea you are both bleeding from many wounds and neither of you can stand. The witnesses declare a draw, and the grudge settled.

You and [holmgang_challenger.GetFirstName] fall upon one another, and splinters fly as axe meets shield. You are evenly matched, and the fight drags on through the day. When the sun sinks into the sea you are both bleeding from many wounds and neither of you can stand. The witnesses declare a draw, and the grudge settled.
Well fought.
[holmgang_loser.GetFirstName] pays you a tenth of [holmgang_loser.GetHerHis] wealth as weregild.
You take a fifth of [holmgang_loser.GetFirstName]'s wealth by holm law.
Grudge settled on the holm
